preconditions.expression: len(s) > 0 and len(s) <= 1000 and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k <= 1000
preconditions.description: Input string s is a non-empty lowercase English letter string of length at most 1000, and integer k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(all(s[i:i+l] == s[i:i+l][::-1] for i in range(0, len(s), l)) for l in [len(s)//k] if len(s) % l == 0) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a positive integer length l = len(s)//k such that s can be partitioned into k substrings of length l, each of which is a palindrome. Otherwise, output is 'NO'.
